content:
Updates the specified tag category. To update a category you must be an admin or have edit
permissions on all tags within the category.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The unique identifier (UUID) of the tag category to update. For more
information on determining this value, see Determine Tag Identifiers.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The name of the tag category. Note that name  must not exceed 127
characters and must not contain colons.
string
The description of the category. Must not exceed 3,000 characters.
tag_category_uuid
required
name
required
description
